title: Component hierarchy / Phân cấp thành phần
content: Decompose an object into macro independent major parts, meso sub-assemblies, and micro feature groups in a parent-child hierarchy.
constraints: Do not treat a component-based object as one monolithic mesh.

title: Local object-space relationship / Quan hệ không gian cục bộ

constraints: State how parts join; adjacency alone is insufficient.

title: Topology intent / Mục đích cấu trúc lưới
content: Topology intent classifies a surface as hard-surface blockout, subdivision-ready, low-poly prop, organic deformed mesh, or alpha-card cluster.
constraints: Choose topology intent before selecting a primitive.

title: Roughness / Độ thô
content: Roughness is microfacet scatter: high roughness reads matte and low roughness reads glossy. Recognition cues: low roughness reads as a sharp, mirror-like, tight specular highlight; high roughness reads as a blurry, wide, dim highlight and matte appearance; worn/scratched regions show broken-up, uneven highlight shapes versus the smooth highlight of pristine areas. Dấu hiệu nhận diện: độ nhám thấp = điểm sáng specular sắc nét, giống gương; độ nhám cao = điểm sáng mờ, rộng, tối, bề mặt trông mờ đục; vùng bị mòn/trầy có hình dạng điểm sáng vỡ vụn so với vùng nguyên vẹn. Three.js target: MeshPhysicalMaterial.roughness (scalar) + .roughnessMap (green channel of packed ORM texture, NoColorSpace).
constraints: Tie each material claim to a distinct component.

title: UV strategy / Chiến lược UV
content: UV strategy can use generated procedural coordinates, cylindrical projection, triplanar-like mapping, or atlas-ready unwrapped regions.
constraints: Select a mapping strategy appropriate to the surface and texture requirements.

title: Runtime hierarchy / Phân cấp thời gian chạy
content: An action-ready model uses a root, component pivot groups, visual meshes, sockets, collider metadata or proxies, and destruction-group metadata.
constraints: Do not deliver a single decorative mesh when future actions need named targets.

title: Socket and pivot / Ổ cắm và điểm xoay
content: A pivot is a local rotation origin; a socket is an attachment point for a child part. In a runtime hierarchy, a socket Object3D is a child of the relevant pivot.
constraints: Name sockets and place them in local coordinates.

title: Attachment contract / Hợp đồng gắn kết
content: An attached child records its parent, parent socket, local start and end, contact type, and embed depth or overlap where applicable.
constraints: Do not place an attached part in mid-air when its attachment cannot be inferred.

title: Confidence and uncertainty / Độ tin cậy và bất định

constraints: Do not invent hidden detail without flagging it as speculative.
